name: weweb.io
long_description: WeWeb is an AI platform for building secure, scalable full-stack applications without writing code. Business teams can build and iterate autonomously, connect the tools they already use through native integrations, and move from idea to production quickly, without waiting on engineering resources. Built-in safeguards give technical leaders confidence that speed doesn’t come at the expense of security, quality, or control.
one_liner: WeWeb is the AI app builder your IT team will approve.
